description.text: Objective: Through some courses study, students could master Chinese teaching skills and have the basic ability of being a Chinese-language teacher. Courses: Chinese Erros Analysis, Teacher's Classroom Language, Chinese Teaching Skills, Chinese Grammar Teaching, Chinese Vocabulary Teaching, Chinese Listening Teaching, Oral Chinese Teaching, Chinese Reading Teaching, Chinese Teaching and Test etc. Notes: The program will open if the number of applicants are over 10 or above. It could accept group and individual registration. Group class could decide the study content and study time.

duration.text: The Chinese-language Teachers Training Program at Ludong University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1111 USD/per semester ￥ 8000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate of HSK If applicable. Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test), No need for English medium programs

requirements.text: 1.(Applicants must be) non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2.(Applicants must) Be in good health 3.(Applicants should be between the) age of 10 to 60
